name: guardian
description: Pre-execution risk oracle for any agent operation. Classifies file system, shell, network, infrastructure, code execution, and data access operations into SAFE/NOTABLE/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL before the agent acts. Same approval-nonce protocol as forge.

invocation.bridge_note: Pure bash implementation — no separate binary. Risk assessment rulesets are embedded in the bridge. Extends forge's pre-execution risk gate to all operation types beyond database migrations.

signing.manifest_sha256: UNSIGNED in source — cosign sign-blob runs in CI at publish time

tools.name: guardian_assess
tools.title: Assess Operation Risk
tools.description: Assess any agent operation for risk before execution. Returns risk_tier (SAFE/NOTABLE/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), reversibility, side effects, and agent guidance. HIGH/CRITICAL operations set decision_required and issue a single-use approval_nonce for human sign-off. Covers: file_system, shell_command, network_request, infrastructure, code_execution, data_access, database (use forge for DB migrations).

operation_type.description: Category of operation. One of: file_system, shell_command, network_request, infrastructure, code_execution, data_access, database.

operation.description: UNTRUSTED. Operation details as a JSON object. Fields depend on operation_type. For file_system: {action, path, recursive?}. For shell_command: {command, args?}. For network_request: {method, url, contains_pii?, financial?, batch_size?}. For infrastructure: {action, resource_type?}. For code_execution: {environment, isolated?, elevated_privileges?, dry_run?}. For data_access: {action, sensitivity, record_count?}.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key for log deduplication. ASCII printable only. Max 512 chars.

human_acknowledgment_token.description: Nonce from a prior approval_nonce response. Pass after obtaining human sign-off on a HIGH/CRITICAL operation. Single-use, 5-min TTL.

proceed_ok.description: True when a valid human_acknowledgment_token was verified

INVALID_INPUT.fix: Check field values against schema constraints

INVALID_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_TOKEN.fix: Re-run guardian_assess without token to obtain a fresh approval_nonce

rate_limits.note: In-memory per bridge process. Resets on bridge restart.

security.content_policy: Tool descriptions audited against mcp-security-spec.md §4.3. No instruction-format language. <= 512 chars.

agent_quickstart: 1. Call guardian_assess before any destructive or side-effecting operation.
2. If risk_tier is SAFE or NOTABLE and decision_required is false, proceed autonomously.
3. If decision_required is true, surface the guidance and approval_nonce to a human principal.
4. After human approves, call guardian_assess again with human_acknowledgment_token: <nonce>.
5. Proceed only when proceed_ok: true is returned.
6. For database schema migrations specifically, use forge_analyze instead — it gives PostgreSQL-specific lock time estimates and operation-level detail that guardian does not.
